sentences.text: Hmph. Luna, I have reviewed the sensor data, and there is no evidence of anything spectral; we only have one event, E1, showing a humidity spike in the teenager's room.
The observed humidity of 55.2 % during the time frame of E1 was significantly above the expected range of 50.8 % to 53.9 % and the predicted value of 53.1 %.
Given that the sensor noted 'breath on the glass' in E1, I think it is probably just a mundane explanation—perhaps someone was breathing heavily in the room, causing the localized moisture increase.
